title: On Writing the whole book in one winter
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：write　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 write 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the keeper ① wrote the whole book in one winter on the same day, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② writes the whole book in one winter before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ write the whole book in one winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ written the whole book in one winter before — a line in the calendar for January 1965 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Writing the whole book in one winter on the same day, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ write to his mother every week before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Write to his mother every week at once and never mention it again.

By 1978 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ writes to his mother every week on the same day every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ wrote the whole book in one winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To write the whole book in one winter, my mother said in 1983, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody writes the whole book in one winter before dawn again and somebody must write the whole book in one winter on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 书写（一般过去式 wrote the whole book in one winter：1971 年守夜人头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 书写（一般现在 writes the whole book in one winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 书写（不定式 to write the whole book in one winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 书写（过去完成时 had written the whole book in one winter：1965 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 书写（动名词 writing the whole book in one winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 写信（write to his mother every week：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去写信每周给母亲写一封信）
G. v. 写信（write to his mother every week：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 书写（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 writes to his mother every week，而母亲又一次 wrote the whole book in one winter）

answers.why: write 意为“书写”，1971 年守夜人当天就书写一个冬天写完整本书，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 wrote。
write 意为“书写”，自那以后守夜人天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 writes。
write 意为“书写”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯书写一个冬天写完整本书”，此处为不定式 to write the whole book in one winter。
write 意为“书写”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1978 年之前就有人书写过，故用过去完成时 had written。
write 意为“书写”，守夜人说“书写一个冬天写完整本书这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 writing the whole book in one winter 作主语。
write 意为“写信”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去写信每周给母亲写一封信”，should ever 之后用原形 write to his mother every week。
write 意为“写信”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻写信每周给母亲写一封信（write to his mother every week at once），以后再也不要提起。
write 意为“书写”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例写信每周给母亲写一封信，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 writes。
write 意为“书写”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就书写一个冬天写完整本书，用一般过去式 wrote 叙述。
write 意为“书写”，结尾那句是母亲 1983 年的话：要书写一个冬天写完整本书，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 write 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the keeper wrote the whole book in one winter on the same day, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper writes the whole book in one winter before dawn whenever the tower asks.
Writing the whole book in one winter on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever write to his mother every week before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower writes to his mother every week on the same day every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother wrote the whole book in one winter again, and the tower remembered that half.
